editor.label: World save name
editor.description: Folder under AbioticFactor/Saved/SaveGames/Server/Worlds. A new name starts a new world.

editor.label: Server password
editor.description: Leave empty for a public server. No spaces.

editor.label: Admin password
editor.description: Players enter it in the game to become admin. Empty = admins only from Admin.ini. No spaces.

editor.label: mod.io mods
editor.description: mod.io ids separated by semicolons (mod.io/g/abiotic-factor). The server downloads them at start-up.

editor.label: mod.io token
editor.description: Optional personal mod.io access token: mods are then cached and their dependencies installed.

editor.label: Difficulty
editor.description: How many enemies appear and how aggressive they are. Above Normal turns off dynamic difficulty.

editor.label: Hardcore mode
editor.description: One life per character; forces Apocalyptic difficulty.

editor.label: Allow the Iron Mode job
editor.description: Needs hardcore mode.

editor.label: Loot respawns
editor.description: Resources respawn around the Facility (not furniture).

editor.label: Sink refill rate
editor.description: 0 = sinks never refill.

editor.label: Food spoil speed
editor.description: 0 = food never spoils.

editor.label: Containers only take their item types
Structural support limit
editor.description: How high furniture and deployables stack. 0 = no limit.

editor.label: Invisible radiation
editor.description: No screen effects; a Geiger counter is needed.

editor.label: Allow local-only mods
editor.description: Players can join with cosmetic mods the server does not run.

editor.label: Damage to allies
editor.description: 1.0 or more for PvP.

editor.label: XP gain
editor.description: 0 = skills never level up.

editor.label: Broken furniture is destroyed
editor.description: Off = it is packaged instead.
